column2: written law, the Foundation shall have the power–

column3: to  request  and  receive  contributions,  grants,
donations and gifts of all forms as may be necessary
for the purpose of the Foundation;
to purchase, rent, lease or otherwise obtain lands or
buildings which may be required for the purpose of
the  Foundation;
to borrow or raise funds with or without interest for
the purposes of the Foundation;
to make, draw, accept, discount, endorse, buy, sell
and  issue  bills  of  exchange,  cheques,  promissory
notes and other negotiable instruments and to open,
operate, maintain and close accounts in any  bank;
to invest any funds that are not immediately required
for the purposes of the Foundation, in such manner
as the Executive Council may deem necessary;
to enter into agreement or contracts with any person
or any company or body of persons with a view to
